title: Package
description: An installable unit belonging to exactly one Publisher.

materialization.description: ADR 0010 D2 defines `ecosystem` and `collection`. Only `collection` is implemented: buildMarketplace always filters to the selected closure, so declaring `ecosystem` today would install the wrong thing silently. The enum is narrowed to the one honest value until the ecosystem path exists.

ref.description: Immutable commit SHA. security-model.md:831-835 forbids `main`/`latest`/`HEAD`; source.js:23 enforces the same pattern at fetch time.

discovery.description: How the upstream's Components are found. ADR 0013 D1: declared per Package, with no fallback between strategies.

strategy.description: `manifest` reads the arrays in the upstream plugin manifest; mattpocock/skills carries 38 SKILL.md but ships 25, so its tree is not its shipping list. `convention` reads the plugin layout instead — five of the six reference ecosystems in README.md carry no component arrays at all. There is no default and no fallback: a manifest that enumerates nothing fails rather than resolving to zero.

manifest.description: Path to the upstream plugin manifest. Required by `strategy: manifest`; under `convention` it is optional and read only for the upstream version.

targets.description: Declared target compatibility. Not read in V1 — sync.js:94 writes `claude-code` literally.

components.description: Curated per-Component metadata. `requires` is declared here, never inferred: scanning bodies is unsound in both directions (packages/cli/README.md:102-117). `ap audit` nominates undeclared edges for a curator.
